# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [Anthropic Signs $11.6 Billion Akamai Cloud Deal](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-akamai-cloud-deal.html): A seven-year CPU-heavy infrastructure contract gives Anthropic more capacity while tying Akamai’s future growth directly to Claude demand.
- [Black Forest Labs Releases Open-Weight FLUX 3 Action](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/flux-3-action-robot-model.html): The 7B model predicts video and robot actions together, placing a visual-generation lab inside the race to build open physical-AI systems.
- [Google Brings Gemini Live Avatar to Enterprise](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/gemini-live-avatar-enterprise.html): Google has made Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar generally available, combining real-time dialogue, synchronized video personas, tools and 97-language support.
- [Google Uses Agents to Stabilize Long-Form AI Video](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/google-long-form-video-agents.html): Google researchers describe a multi-agent video system that tracks characters and environments across minutes, addressing continuity drift in generative storytelling.
- [LangChain Turns Agent Traces Into Fine-Tuning Data](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/langsmith-agent-fine-tuning.html): LangChain has launched LangSmith Fine-Tuning and smithtune, linking agent traces, managed training and evaluation into one workflow for custom models.
- [White House Asks Labs to Delay UK Model Testing](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/white-house-uk-model-testing.html): Washington reportedly wants OpenAI and Anthropic to give American reviewers first access, challenging the UK’s role in frontier-model safety testing.
- [Claude identifies a CRISPR-like enzyme system in phages](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/claude-finds-crispr-like-enzyme.html): Anthropic says Claude agents found an uncharacterized reverse-transcriptase system after screening 200,000 proteins and guiding lab validation.
- [Cursor adds deployment monitoring and security review bots](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/cursor-rollouts-security-review.html): Cursor launched Rollouts and Security Review, two enterprise bots that monitor production changes and inspect pull requests for exploitable flaws.
- [Google launches Gemini models for programmable voice design](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/google-gemini-voice-design.html): Google’s new Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS models let users design voices, direct performances line by line and generate speech across 100 languages.
- [Meta Expands Muse Agent Across Glasses, Apps and Services](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/meta-muse-expands-across-devices.html): Meta is extending Muse from a standalone personal agent into a cross-device assistant with new connectors, computer control and wearable access.
- [Alibaba introduces Qwen Intelligence for mobile agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/qwen-intelligence-mobile-agents.html): Alibaba unveiled Qwen Intelligence with mobile planning, device-use and creative agents, aiming to make smartphone assistants act across apps.
- [Tencent Puts 33-Language Translation on Devices Offline](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/tencent-hy-translation-offline-app.html): Tencent’s new Hy Translation app brings Hy-MT2 to phones with offline text, voice and image translation across 33 languages and Chinese dialects.
- [Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5.5 with lower costs](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-claude-opus-55-release.html): Anthropic launched Claude Opus 5.5 with Fable-level performance claims, lower operating costs and stronger safeguards for cybersecurity work.
- [OpenAI launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna at half the price](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-gpt6-sol-luna-cut-costs.html): OpenAI released GPT-6 Sol and Luna for ChatGPT, Codex and API users, targeting cheaper agent workloads with broadly similar performance.
- [Qwen-Audio 3.1 Expands Alibaba’s Full-Stack Voice Offering](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/qwen-audio-31-expands-voice-stack.html): Alibaba’s Qwen-Audio 3.1 adds specialized creation and understanding models while sharply cutting prices for speech workloads.

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [Anthropic与Akamai签署116亿美元云计算协议](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-akamai-cloud-deal.html): 这份为期七年的协议以CPU算力为重点，让Anthropic锁定更多基础设施，也把Akamai的增长前景绑定到Claude需求上。
- [Black Forest Labs开源权重机器人模型FLUX 3 Action](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/flux-3-action-robot-model.html): 这款70亿参数模型同时预测视频与机器人动作，让视觉生成实验室正式进入开放式具身智能竞争。
- [谷歌将Gemini Live Avatar推向企业正式部署](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/gemini-live-avatar-enterprise.html): 谷歌宣布Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar正式进入Gemini Enterprise，融合实时对话、同步视频形象、工具调用与97种语言支持。
- [谷歌用多智能体系统解决长视频一致性难题](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/google-long-form-video-agents.html): 谷歌研究团队公布多智能体视频框架，通过视觉记忆、分段生成和闭环评审，维持分钟级故事中的人物与场景一致性。
- [LangChain把智能体轨迹接入模型微调流程](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/langsmith-agent-fine-tuning.html): LangChain推出LangSmith Fine-Tuning与开源命令行工具smithtune，把智能体轨迹、托管训练和评估串成一条工作流。
- [白宫要求AI公司暂缓向英国提供新模型测试](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/white-house-uk-model-testing.html): 据报道，华盛顿希望OpenAI和Anthropic先接受美国审查，再向英国开放新模型，英国前沿模型测试优势面临挑战。
- [Claude在噬菌体中发现类CRISPR酶系统](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/claude-finds-crispr-like-enzyme.html): Anthropic称，Claude智能体从20万个逆转录酶中筛出候选系统，并通过实验确认其具有此前未被注释的结构特征。
- [Cursor推出部署监控与代码安全审查智能体](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/cursor-rollouts-security-review.html): Cursor发布Rollouts和Security Review两款企业级智能体，分别监控部署回归并检查代码提交中的可利用漏洞。
- [谷歌推出可编程声音设计的Gemini语音模型](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/google-gemini-voice-design.html): Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS系列支持用自然语言设计声音、逐句控制表演，并覆盖100多种语言和方言。
- [Meta扩展Muse：接入眼镜、电脑与第三方服务](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/meta-muse-expands-across-devices.html): Meta正把Muse从独立个人智能体扩展为跨设备平台，新增眼镜入口、电脑控制、专属邮箱和一批服务连接器。
- [阿里推出Qwen Intelligence布局手机智能体](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/qwen-intelligence-mobile-agents.html): 阿里Qwen团队发布Qwen Intelligence，围绕手机规划、操作和创作推出三款智能体，试图让助手跨应用执行任务。
- [腾讯推出Hy翻译：33种语言支持端侧离线互译](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/tencent-hy-translation-offline-app.html): 腾讯上线Hy翻译App，基于Hy-MT2提供33种语言及多种汉语方言的文字、语音和图片离线翻译。
- [Anthropic发布Claude Opus 5.5，性能提升同时降本](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-claude-opus-55-release.html): Anthropic推出Claude Opus 5.5，称其达到Fable 5.1级别表现，运行成本下降40%，并强化网络安全防护。
- [OpenAI发布GPT-6 Sol与Luna，价格降至上一代一半](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-gpt6-sol-luna-cut-costs.html): OpenAI推出GPT-6 Sol和Luna，登陆ChatGPT、Codex与API，重点以更低成本支撑大规模智能体任务。
- [通义千问发布 Audio 3.1，语音模型全面扩容并降价](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/qwen-audio-31-expands-voice-stack.html): 阿里通义千问推出覆盖识别、合成、实时交互与音频创作的 Audio 3.1 系列，并大幅下调语音调用价格。

- [RSS English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss.xml) / [RSS 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss-zh.xml): machine-readable feeds

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
